note: Both sets capture the main elevation datums, siding/cladding, handrail and cable-railing specs, and the 2 x APSE-20 solar thermal array, but Set B additionally records the 40 TUBES total, a substantive quantity fact Set A omits. Set A binds the W1/W2 marks correctly as identifiers and keeps the steel condition on the cable, whereas Set B mis-binds those marks as "dimension" and garbles one cable value ("1/8\" steel in"). Set A, however, is padded with roughly a dozen duplicate or trivial restatements (handrail, siding, grade level, finished floor and tube claims each repeated 2-4 times) and both sets invent a "roof/overhang" entity for the PV array. On balance B is the more informative and less noisy set despite its extra misbindings.
remarks: Both sets miss notable page facts: CEMENT FIBRE BOARD SIDING, POWDERCOATED STEEL FLATBAR RAILING POSTS (with 2x4 cedar handrail), and the general sheet notes (Hardie installation reference A-511, larger spacing permitted between solar thermal tube arrays with valves/piping not shown, dotted/layered door swing convention). Both invent a "roof/overhang" entity to host the PV SOLAR ARRAY labels, which the page does not name. Set A's South Elevation scale value is garbled ("1/4\" per 1'-0\" inches per foot"); Set B's cable value is garbled ("1/8\" steel in") and it labels the 1/8\" cable size as "thickness". Text layer contains the source typo "TONNGUE", faithfully quoted by both.
